scripts.dev:all: concurrently --color always --names "server,mobile" --prefix-colors "green,yellow" "pnpm run dev" "cd frontend && npx expo run:android"
scripts.dev: concurrently --color always --names "backend-main,backend-worker,load-balancer,admin-web,website" --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,yellow,magenta,green" "npm run dev:backend-main" "npm run dev:backend-worker" "npm run dev:lb" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:backend-main: cd backend && set PORT=3000&& set PORT_V1=4000&& set PORT_V2=4001&& set PORT_ADMIN=5000&& set ENABLE_ADMIN_API=true&& pnpm dev
scripts.dev:backend-worker: cd backend && set PORT=3002&& set PORT_V1=4002&& set PORT_V2=4003&& set ENABLE_ADMIN_API=false&& pnpm dev
scripts.dev:lb: cd load-balancer && set PORT=8080&& set MAIN_INSTANCE_URL=http://localhost:3000&& set WORKER_URLS=http://localhost:3002&& pnpm start
scripts.dev:cluster: concurrently --color always --names "backend-main,backend-worker,load-balancer" --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,yellow" "npm run dev:backend-main" "npm run dev:backend-worker" "npm run dev:lb"
